name: AP_DOC_SEQUENCE_AUDIT
description: AP_DOC_SEQUENCES_AUDIT contains audit information for document sequence numbers assigned to invoices and payments.  Document sequence numbers are used to create unique, sequential, voucher numbers for referencing invoices and payments. . Each document sequence is defined with a range of numbers.  A document sequence is assigned to a document category which, in turn, is assigned to a document (invoice or payment) during creation. . When a number for a document sequence is assigned to an invoice or payment, your Oracle Payables application creates a row in this table for the number.  Your Oracle Payables application uses the records in this table to verify the availability of a number for a particular document sequence before allowing the number to be assigned to a document.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that identifies the document sequence defined in the application.

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for document category to which document sequence is assigned

columns.name: DOC_SEQUENCE_VALUE
columns.description: Document sequence value (voucher number) assigned to an invoice or payment

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
